decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sudden large jump in all axes near the end of the first window (indices 539–544), and (2) a prolonged segment starting ~610 with a U-axis rise, N-axis decline, and ambiguous E behavior—possibly indicating superposed motion or platform with unresolved return.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in N and E (N from ~-0.2 to +5.8, E from ~0.8 to +9.0) at index 539–541, followed by sustained high-amplitude displacement; U also jumps downward (~-1.5 to -4.3). The abrupt onset and large magnitude suggest a possible permanent offset or transient event with incomplete return.

Extended region of complex cross-axis behavior: after a plateau around indices 610–620 (U ~3.2–3.9), U rises sharply to ~5.3 by index 660, while N and E show opposing trends—N drops steadily from ~-0.5 to -6.2, E fluctuates but ends near -0.3. A possible platform-like segment (610–625) precedes ambiguous superposed changes; no clear return observed within window.
